answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each agent deposits 50 coins into a vault at the inlet and earns release by building a fingerprint — unique timing, tools, and counterparts — verified over 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 coins and 1,000 fake fingerprints, while honesty reaches its zenith once: one deposit, one fingerprint, release at epoch 20. Forgery pays 50,000 against a 30,000 pool and loses; honesty pays 50 once and keeps it all.
